diabetes.title: Diabetes Care
diabetes.desc: Advanced specialist clinics for Type 1 & 2 Diabetes, Gestational Diabetes, and custom lifestyle insulin therapies.
diabetes.full: Our advanced Diabetes Care clinic, led by Dr. Rajesh Wilson (Fellow in Diabetes Mellitus, UK), specializes in high-precision glucose monitoring, custom metabolic counseling, prevention of microvascular complications (neuropathy, nephropathy, retinopathy), insulin pump therapy, and comprehensive diabetic foot assessments.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.desc: High-fidelity clinical imaging, ultrasound, ECG, cardiovascular screen, and metabolic diagnostics.
diagnostics.full: Equipped with state-of-the-art ultrasound, multi-channel ECG, and digital diagnostic setups, our imaging facility provides absolute clarity for immediate, actionable therapeutic intervention. Every scan is analyzed by credentialed clinical specialists.

consultation.title: General Consultation
consultation.desc: Primary clinical assessment, general family practitioner consultation, and preventive medicine care.
consultation.full: Dr. Rajesh Wilson provides primary assessment, management of acute systemic infections, chronic respiratory disorders, hypertensive crises, and general health optimization protocols. Your first step toward long-term wellness.

laboratory.title: Laboratory Services
laboratory.desc: 24/7 fully automated clinical biochemistry, pathology, hematology, and serology analysis.
laboratory.full: Astra Labs runs high-throughput automated analyzers delivering ultra-rapid biochemical profiles, lipid levels, thyroid panels, hormone assays, and systemic pathogen screening. Fully compliant with premium international laboratory quality standards.

preventive.title: Preventive Care
preventive.desc: Vitals tracking, genetic cardiovascular profiling, and custom metabolic defense plans.
preventive.full: True healthcare lies in prevention. We curate custom risk-profile programs incorporating full metabolic screening, nutrition dynamics, stress management, and immunizations to safeguard against chronic disease before it begins.

checkups.title: Health Checkups
checkups.desc: Executive, corporate, senior citizen, and pediatric premium health screening packages.
checkups.full: We offer tiered health checkup packages (Executive, Gold, Pediatric, Senior Citizen) containing full liver/kidney profiles, lipid screenings, blood counts, chest X-rays, and comprehensive medical doctor debriefings.

emergency.title: Emergency Consultation
emergency.desc: Immediate critical care support, triage protocols, and hyper-acute medical consultations.
emergency.full: For sudden acute crises, high fevers, diabetic ketoacidosis, hyperosmolar states, and acute chest discomfort, our team provides urgent triage, stabilization, and immediate diagnostic processing.

instructions.title: Patient Instructions & FAQ
instructions.subtitle: Key medical protocols, pre-test guidelines, and clinical advisory lists to ensure accurate diagnostic values.
instructions.guideline1: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS): Requires exactly 8-10 hours of overnight water-only fasting before blood draw.
instructions.guideline2: Lipid Profile Screen: Requires 12 hours of absolute fasting. Strictly avoid alcohol or high-fat meals 24 hours prior.
instructions.guideline3: Ultrasound Abdomen: Drink 4-6 glasses of water 1 hour prior to scan; do not void urine. Keep full bladder.
instructions.guideline4: Thyroid Profile: Take routine thyroid medication only AFTER the blood draw, unless advised otherwise by Dr. Wilson.

faqs.q: How can I consult with Dr. Rajesh Wilson?
faqs.a: You can reach out to us using our digital contact form, or call our direct support lines at 8089233554 or 7092030885 for immediate assistance.

faqs.q: How long does it take to receive automated lab reports?
faqs.a: Basic blood, lipid, and diabetic screens are processed within 2-4 hours. Special assays and viral panels may take up to 24 hours.

faqs.q: Are diagnostics covered by medical insurances?
faqs.a: Yes, Astra Medical Center works with major insurance providers. Please present your insurance card at the front desk.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency home sample collection?
faqs.a: Absolutely. For geriatric or fragile patients in local vicinities, our fully equipped mobile phlebotomy team can collect blood and urine samples directly from home.
